name: tenant-provisioning-service
description: Multi-tenant SaaS signup, Stripe payment setup and per-tenant AWS provisioning

scripts.offline: cross-env STAGE=$npm_config_stage APPLICATION=$npm_config_application OFFLINE=true node -r ./scripts/loadEnv scripts/deploy.js
scripts.deploy-tenant: cross-env STAGE=$npm_config_stage APPLICATION=$npm_config_application TENANT_ID=$npm_config_tenant node -r ./scripts/loadEnv scripts/deploy-tenant.js

author: Tochukwu Ozurumba (Tueloper)
